Roblox Game Developer at SuperGaming

About the Role

 

SuperGaming builds world-class games played by over 200 million players, including MaskGun, Silly Royale, Indus Battle Royale, and SuperPlatform (the live-ops engine behind PAC-MAN). 
We’re now bringing that expertise to Roblox, where creativity meets scale.

We’re looking for talented Roblox Developers who love building polished, high-performance experiences that millions of players can enjoy together, whether it’s a tactical shooter, a social sports world, or a live-ops-driven event space. 
If you’re fluent in Lua, obsessed with performance, and thrive on solving complex gameplay and systems challenges, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Do

Develop, optimize, and ship Roblox experiences end-to-end using Roblox Studio and Lua scripting.
Implement gameplay systems, UI, and multiplayer features with clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
Collaborate with designers and artists to turn creative ideas into functional, fun gameplay.
Build and balance UGC systems, in-game economies, and live-ops features that keep players engaged.
Contribute to core architecture decisions for performance, stability, and scalability across devices.
Debug, profile, and optimize gameplay systems for low-end and mobile performance.
Participate actively in design and playtesting sessions, providing feedback on mechanics, flow, and feel.
Stay updated on Roblox platform updates, APIs, and best practices to push the limits of what’s possible.

What You Bring

1+ years of experience developing on Roblox with Lua scripting.
Deep understanding of Roblox Studio, gameplay mechanics, and multiplayer systems.
Ability to prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback.
Experience deploying and maintaining live Roblox experiences.
Solid understanding of client-server replication, data stores, and network optimization.
Strong problem-solving skills and a love for clean, efficient code.
Collaborative mindset and should be comfortable working across disciplines in a fast-paced team.
Passion for creating experiences that players talk about, share, and come back to.

Bonus Points

Experience shipping a live Roblox title with measurable success.
Knowledge of Free-to-Play (F2P) systems, progression loops, or in-game economies.
Background in Unity (C#) or other modern game engines.
Familiarity with analytics and telemetry tools for balancing and tuning.
Interest in competitive, shooter, or sports gameplay systems.
Why This Role Matters

Roblox is rapidly evolving from small creator projects to studio-scale productions and SuperGaming is at the forefront of that shift.
 

With over 100M+ daily players, a maturing audience, and major investments into shooters, sports, and RPGs, this is a rare opportunity to help shape what the next generation of Roblox experiences will look and feel like.

 

At SuperGaming, you’ll be working alongside developers who’ve shipped global hits, built custom live-ops tech, and understand the balance between fun, polish, and performance.
You’ll have the creative freedom to prototype fast, ship boldly, and scale your work to millions of players worldwide.


What You’ll Get

A chance to build the next generation of Roblox games with AAA-level quality and creative freedom. 
Collaboration with Roblox’s own developer relations and platform teams.
The stability of a proven studio with the agility of a startup strike team.
Access to SuperGaming’s SuperPlatform tools for live-ops, analytics, and backend services.

 

Join SuperGaming and help define what world-class game development on Roblox looks like
